<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
BoundExecutable(executable, bindings, bound_names=None)
```

Part of [`evoxc.pipeline`](/api/evoxc/pipeline/)

Result of `evoxc.bind`: an executable with pre-supplied inputs.

Also satisfies the runnable surface of `Executable` (so `evoxc.run`
accepts it), supplying the bound tensors before user-provided arguments.

## Attributes

- `executable` — the wrapped `Executable`.

- `bindings` — dict mapping flat-input-LEAF-INDEX -> validated
  `core.Tensor` (positions resolved by `bind()`).

- `bound_names` — dict mapping binding name -> flat leaf index (for
  diagnostics).

## backend

Backend name the wrapped executable runs on (delegates).

## backend_executable

The wrapped executable's backend executable.

## device

Device the wrapped executable is bound to.

## functions

Function names exported by the loaded program (delegates to the
wrapped executable).

## plan_text

```python
plan_text()
```

The backend's execution-plan text, or `None` when it has none.

Delegates to the wrapped `Executable.plan_text()` (backends without a
textual plan return `None`). Pure inspection: executes nothing and
populates no plan cache.

## signature

The wrapped executable's `Signature`.

## summary

```python
summary() -> dict
```

JSON-safe inspection snapshot of this bound executable.

Delegates to the wrapped `Executable.summary()` and adds a
`bound_count` key; the input side is REDUCED to the unbound
signature whenever the cheap derivation is available (`input_count`
and `input_specs` then describe only the inputs a caller still
supplies, while `input_tree` stays the full recorded tree), and
delegated unchanged otherwise. Pure inspection — never runs, traces,
compiles, or populates a cache.
Rendering: `evoxc._inspect.bound_executable_summary`.

## synchronize

```python
synchronize()
```

Wait for all device work submitted by previous `run` calls on the
wrapped executable (delegates to `self.executable.synchronize()`).

Exists so an `evoxc.bind(...)` result exposes the exact same call
shape as the underlying `Executable`. Returns `None`.
